02. MODULAR SHORTCUT ARCHITECTURE

YOUR WORKFLOW, ONE PRESS AWAY.YOUR WORKFLOW, ONE PRESS AWAY.

Browse example shortcut tiles across four creative disciplines. Click any tile to assign it directly to Slot 01 in the virtual simulator above.

CREATE · COLOR GRADE

COLOR GRADE

Toggle illustrative color treatment presets (Neutral Rec.709, Cobalt Punch, Voltage Warm) in the studio preview.

REAL HARDWARE CONTEXT:Editors bind repetitive grading macros, node trees, and preview toggles to dedicated tactile keys.
CREATE · ADD MARKER

DROP MARKER

Stamp a timeline edit marker onto the simulated NLE sequence bar for fast post-production review.

REAL HARDWARE CONTEXT:Mark funny moments, audio flubs, or beat drops while recording or reviewing footage.
CREATE · SPLIT CLIP

RAZOR SPLIT

Simulate a playhead blade cut across active timeline tracks and log the edit point.

REAL HARDWARE CONTEXT:Replace complex three-finger keyboard chords with a single labeled key press.
CREATE · EXPORT H264

RENDER DRAFT

Run a simulated fast-pass proxy export in the studio monitor and record completion in Run Log.

REAL HARDWARE CONTEXT:Trigger export presets, media encoder queues, or project backups with zero menu diving.
CREATE · SMOOTH EASE

KEYFRAME EASE

Apply a simulated cubic-bezier velocity curve to selected motion keyframes in the studio preview.

REAL HARDWARE CONTEXT:Motion designers map easing scripts and layer alignments to a dedicated Studio profile.
CREATE · A/B BYPASS

A/B LUT CHECK

Quickly flip between graded and ungraded monitor states to verify skin tones and shadow contrast.

REAL HARDWARE CONTEXT:Instant visual verification during color sessions without moving the mouse cursor.
CREATE · DUCK BGM -12

VOICE DUCKING

Dip simulated background music track by -12dB so voiceover commentary cuts through cleanly.

REAL HARDWARE CONTEXT:Balance background music and dialogue tracks on the fly during live edits or podcasts.
